releaseNotes: Fix: 5"/7"/jc8048w550c (RGB-parallel panels) no longer show a static white column artifact on the trailing edge of every scan line -- root cause was LovyanGFX's ESP32-S3 RGB driver never using ESP-IDF's real bounce-buffered panel driver (esp_lcd_new_rgb_panel), just a hand-rolled DMA path with no bounce buffer. Confirmed on real hardware: eliminates the artifact entirely on both previously-affected physical units (an earlier, more conservative GDMA-tuning-only attempt only partially helped one of them).
Fix: 5" boot splash now defaults to the correct (flipped) orientation for this board's standard mounting, instead of showing upside-down until Companion connects and applies its own saved rotation.

Change: Sidekick model IDs shortened to match a renamed catalog on the Companion side (e.g. esp32-5in -> esp32-5, amoled-191 -> esp32-oled) -- internal identifier only, no user-visible behavior change.

Fix: 5"/7" (RGB-parallel panels) now compose each incoming card in an off-screen PSRAM buffer before blitting it to the display, instead of decoding the JPEG straight onto the live, continuously-scanned panel buffer -- substantially reduces visible tearing/jitter when the card changes.

Fix: AMOLED 1.91" now boots directly into landscape (its native/default orientation) instead of portrait -- the boot-splash rotation had never been set for this board, so it fell back to the firmware's generic default.

Improve: boot-splash text (model name + firmware version) is now sized dynamically per line to fill the actual panel width, instead of a small fixed size -- most noticeable on AMOLED, whose old fixed size was tuned for its narrower portrait width even when booting landscape.
WIP -- not yet confirmed working, do not ship: investigating random noise on the trailing few columns of every line on 5" (RGB-parallel) panels. Root cause still open.
